title: Meh
text:
There are a few toys (around 3-5 medium size toys) in each box and something treaty. Most recent box was a small kicker bag, catnip "wine", catnip, a small anthropomorphic playing card toy, and a stick dangler with elastic string. Value will depend on how dear $20 is to you. I'm at the "themes better be on point for this price".

There are themes to each. Last one was texting/emojis, most recent was Las Vegas. Biggest turn off for me was that the themes don't match the season. I'd be totally down for the content of the boxes if it meant getting Halloween toys, harvest toys, Chinese new years toys, pastel spring toys.

I think they'd be better off also trading in one of the medium toys for a few smaller toys to bump up the quantity factor. Like a small ball and two springs, whose colors match the theme. That would help offset if one of the items proved to be a dudd.
label: neutral
